Mercenary ecology: exact mercenary owners total 375,000; Four Bastion Corps are separate permanent House Tang exact force owners totaling 110,000 and never mercenary-market bodies.

Sword Manor is a permanent House Tang troop-house field force. Its current 30,060 bodies are persistently organized under Sword Manor Field Command; it is not a public school, institutional manpower pool, or mobilization-only force.

House Tang Field Army is commanded by Tang Zhu with Tang Ling as deputy and permanently nests Sword Manor, the Four Bastion Corps, House Guard, Guardian Cavalry, and Tang Champions as whole subordinate commands. Tang Wei Field Army can attach as one intact recursive command when ordered.

Four Bastion Corps are a permanent nested branch of the House Tang Field Army. Their normal fortress-defense station and doctrine remain distinct; command nesting does not imply automatic co-movement on every deployment.
notes: House Tang Grand Field Army is the single top-level recursive House military command under Tang Zhu with Tang Ling as deputy. Sword Manor, Four Bastion Corps, House Guard, Guardian Cavalry, and Tang Champions are subordinate commands within that one army; they are not independent armies.

Tang Manor default defense in depth assigns Four Bastion Corps to the outer wall/perimeter, Sword Manor to the city/interior belt, and House Guard/Guardian Cavalry/Tang Champions to the Inner Citadel and mobile decisive reserve. These are quality-preserving doctrinal defaults, not hard reassignment locks.
